why_not: Implementer page for the same event as the selected AMI item; one event, one row.

why_not: Confirms the DGI holds the register and references an unnumbered ministerial arrete creating the NIF; a procedure sheet rather than the instrument.

why_not: Its 34,757 DGI debtors in 2022 is a portfolio under management, not the size of the taxpayer register; would mislabel the indicator.

why_not: Fetched back as navigation chrome only, about 1,100 characters of Loading component placeholders; the source PDF was used instead. Drop code unfetchable.

title: Tele-services
why_not: Undated service page; confirms the STT and teleservices portals exist but adds nothing the strategic plan does not carry.

why_not: The strongest strategic statement of the SNIS position, but already staged by another slice as the baseline for dpi.exchange--interoperability-of-health-systems. Drop code already-seen.

publisher: Countdown to 2030 with the Ministry of Health, ANSADE and INRSP

title: ATELIER DE LANCEMENT DU PROJET DIGISANTE-MR
why_not: The DigiSante-MR launch of 3 February 2026 appears only as a listing entry with a truncated intro; a headline-only stub, and the pilot is already covered by another slice.

title: Lancement de la plateforme de gestion des stocks national en medicaments essentiels
why_not: Index page whose only full article is a CNASS workshop held in May 2025, outside the window; the stock platform itself is a stub.

why_not: Substantive and concrete — an electronic consultation register went live at Timbedra on 16 October 2025 and Amourj on 17 October 2025 — but the page carries no publication date at all, so it could not be dated from the source.

title: Arrete n 1236 du 23 nov. 2022 creating the SAMU
why_not: Carried in the same Journal Officiel extract as the selected arrete; a different act, not a health information system.

title: GF-OIG-24-005 audit report
publisher: Global Fund Office of the Inspector General
why_not: Its finding that about 30 per cent of facilities did not report malaria data in DHIS2 in 2022 is programme-specific, not SNIS coverage.

title: Mauritania Social Safety Net System Project — Implementation Completion and Results Report ICR00005249
why_not: Selected as the baseline and staged, then withdrawn: another slice had staged the same URL concurrently. It remains in the queue.

why_not: The strongest CNASS movement in the window, but already staged by another slice. Drop code already-seen.

why_not: A coverage campaign rather than an information system; the CNSS 2025-2029 digitisation is mentioned only in passing.

why_not: The same event as the selected baseline, reported by the news agency; primary ministry account preferred.
